mapper.select: SELECT event_content_id AS eventId, event_name AS title, event_type AS category, event_start_date AS startDate, event_end_date AS endDate, event_place AS place, mapy AS lat, mapx AS lng, use_fee AS fee, free_yn AS freeYn, overview, image_url AS imageUrl, homepage, tel_no AS inquiry, district_name AS district, date_text AS dateText, event_start_time AS startTime, event_end_time AS endTime, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM favorite_event f WHERE f.user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND f.event_content_id = e.event_content_id) AS favorited FROM event e WHERE e.event_content_id = #{eventId}
